name: Sakura Taisen 3 ~Paris wa Moeteiru ka~
original_name: サクラ大戦３～巴里は燃えているか～
source: After events of Sakura Taisen 2 Ichiro Oogami comes to Paris to become a leader of a new formed Paris Kagekidan. In Paris the cover for Kagekidan is not a theatre but carnaval where the members of Paris Kagekidan dancing. New enemies and new romances waits for our protagonist. The members of Paris Kagekidan are: 16-year old nun in training, naive and clumsy Erica Fontaine, heir of old noble family Glycine Bleumer who strongly disrespect the protagonist at first, typical Yamato Nadeshiko, 1/4 French 3/4 Japanese Hanabi Kitaōji, 11-year old Vietnam Orphan who was raised up as a young magician in a circus - Coquelicot and dangerous criminal Lobelia Carlini who warks for Kagekidan for money and to shorten her 1000-year term in prison.
translation: 《樱花大战2》事件结束后，大神一郎来到巴黎，出任新成立的巴黎华击团团长。在巴黎，华击团的掩护设施不再是剧院，而是由巴黎华击团成员献舞的娱乐场所。新的敌人与新的恋情正在等待主人公。巴黎华击团的成员包括：十六岁的见习修女、天真冒失的艾莉卡·芳汀；古老贵族世家的继承人、起初极其轻视主人公的库莉希奴·布鲁梅尔；拥有四分之一法国血统、四分之三日本血统的典型大和抚子北大路花火；在马戏团中被培养成小魔术师的十一岁越南孤儿蔻库莉可；以及为金钱和缩短一千年刑期而替华击团工作的危险罪犯罗贝莉娅·卡尔里尼。
